messages:
Ethan Wu: heads-up — NovaHealth (trial) is stuck at activation. Customer sees 403 on embedding ingest and onboarding UI stuck at 'verifying org'. Renewal/convert conversation in ~9 days. Escalating to CS, please advise. ticket: https://zendesk.example/ticket/5692 :warning:

support-bot: New ticket created by Support — #5692 — payload: 
user: @nova_onboarding, error: 403 Forbidden on POST /ingest, attempts: 3. Assigned to @Ethan Wu.

Samira Patel: thanks Ethan. Can you paste the error logs and which env (prod vs sandbox)? I’ll pull the account health + usage. :mag:

Ethan Wu: sandbox provisioned, but they ran production creds by mistake. Logs (sanitized):
```
403 POST /v1/embeddings  - {"error":"forbidden","reason":"key not authorized for tenant 7091"}
audit: oauth2 token with org_id mismatch
```
Workaround we gave: rotate key + repro on sandbox key. I already sent them a temp sandbox key.

Luis Gomez: quick fix path: ensure SSO SCIM mapping includes external_id = tenant_id and rotate the ingestion API key. Minimal prod patch: update header check to allow org_id alias for 24h. I can push a routing rule if we schedule an immediate small deploy. Example config we applied for workaround:
```
# temporary routing rule
match: header.org_alias == "nova-7091"
route: allow-ingest-temp
ttl: 86400
```

Marta Ivanova: Ok — high level comms plan: 1) Immediate customer sync (today 4pm PT) to explain cause + short-term workaround, 2) Enablement session for their platform team (tomorrow), 3) Confirm production key rotation and scoped rollback window, 4) Follow-up doc + NPS touch before renewal. I’ll own the customer comms. @Samira please confirm. :calendar:

Samira Patel: I’ll run account health: showing heavy embedding usage (30k tokens/day), trial feature set used. Renewal risk marked: medium-high if activation not resolved within 48h. Assign AE for renewal touch: @Marta to coordinate. I’ll log playbook steps and create a follow-up in Gainsight.

Ethan Wu: customer is on PST. 4pm PT works. They accepted temp sandbox key and saw ingest succeed once. Still blocked on prod scope.

Luis Gomez: I can stand by during the 4pm sync and deploy the routing rule if they want immediate traffic. If we deploy, we should include a TTL and an automated rollback. I’ll prepare a short runbook snippet.

Marta Ivanova: Agreement: do the customer sync, apply routing rule only if they ask for live traffic, confirm key rotation within 24h. Comms to customer will include: what happened, short-term workaround, exact ETA for prod-safe fix, and a credit offer for incident.

Samira Patel: internal tasks list I added: 
- Create CS playbook note (Samira)
- AE outreach + renewal note (Marta)
- SE standby + routing PR (Luis)
- Confirm ticket status and mark P1 (Ethan)
I set reminders for 24h and 72h.

Ethan Wu: updated ticket with logs and proposed steps. Marking P1. zendesk: https://zendesk.example/ticket/5692/updates

Marta Ivanova: I’ll draft the customer email and drop in thread for sign-off before sending. Thanks team — let’s try to get this wrapped within the trial window. :muscle:
